Commentary.Commentary: The target is not a tough one but Ireland will have to bat really well to chase this down. The conditions, by judging after the first ball bowled, seem to be good for bowling. If England get it right, they can surely defend this. An exciting 4th innings awaits. Join us in a while.
Mark Adair was the pick of the bowlers for Ireland. Thompson too was good as he picked a three-fer. Murtagh was consistent with his lines and lengths and Rankin too did a decent job.

England headed into their second innings trailing by 122 runs. They lost Burns early but Roy and Leach's 145-run stand put England back on track. However, a middle order collapse saw England struggling, with their lead at 126 and 8 wickets down. Handy contributions from Sam Curran and Broad saw them get close to 200. They were hopeful of the last pair adding some runs today morning but that was not to be as Thompson knocked Stone over on the first ball of the day itself.

Just the one ball, yes you read it right, just the one ball it has taken Ireland to take the last wicket. 182 is what is Ireland's target and they would head into the break sensing a serious opportunity to get their first Test victory.

OUT! Bowled! England are bowled out in the first ball off the day! Thompson steams in and bowls a full, inswinging ball on off. It comes back in, Stone looks to drive straight but the ball goes between the gap of bat and pad. It goes onto to demolish the leg pole. England bowled out for 303. Ireland need 182 to win.

After a slight delay we are all set to begin the first session of Day 3. Overnight batsmen, Stuart Broad and Olly Stone walk out to resume their innings. Stuart Thompson to bowl the first over of the Day for Ireland.
Good news the shower has passed and we are about to start play at 1110 Local (1010 GMT).
Update 1100 Local (1000 GMT) - Oh no! We do not have a good news to begin with. It is raining at Lord's and the covers are on. We will have a delayed start here. Stay tuned for further updates.

Welcome to Day 3 of this one-off Test between England and Ireland. Day 2 was another action packed day as both teams took the lead in the game but in the end it was Ireland who ended the day on top. England batting once again saw a collapse as they found themselves from 171/1 to 248/8. Sam Curran's cameo along with Broad in the end saw England edge past the 170-run mark. This might be the last day of this Test and at this point in time one feels the match is right in the balance. There was rain earlier in the day but the forecast for the day looks good, let's hope that it stays true and we do not have any interruptions in what promises to be another exciting day of Test cricket.
... Day 3, Morning Session ...

Now then what is in store for us tomorrow? More rain? An England win or an Ireland win? If the weather stays good, it could well be the last day of this Test match. England lead by 181 at the moment. They would hope they can somehow get past the 200-run mark. Ireland on the other hand, need to get the last wicket quickly and then bat well. Another exciting day of cricket awaits. Join us at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

What a day of cricket we have had! It was Ireland who entered the day as favorites and started off well by sending Burns back early. However, England then fought back courtesy a 145-run stand between Roy and Leach which turned the tide back into England's favour. However, once the two fell, the procession started. England slipped from 171/1 to 248/8. Curran then counter-attacked, played a handy innings, and was well supported by Broad and the two took England close to 300. Sam did fall but Broad and Stone ensure they take England past 300 and they are not yet done.
So that is it! It was inevitable once the players went off and it was even more obvious once the rain arrived. STUMPS HAVE BEEN CALLED ON DAY 2!

Update - 1815 local - The umpires have asked the players to walk off the field. There was lightning early on which was not spotted by the umpires but the sound of thunder has forced them to walk off. Also, it has gotten quite dark there so it is not suitable conditions to continue. We have some news for you, if they do not resume till 1830 local then Stumps will be called.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Stone lets it go to the keeper.
Short ball from Thompson on the body, Broad clears his front leg and pulls it deep mid-wicket.
Broad clears his front leg but it is bowled very full on middle, Broad hits it towards point.
Full delivery on off stump, Broad pushes it towards mid off.
The umpires are having a discussion about the lights here. The ground staff are also getting ready but the umpires agree to continue for now.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed to covers.
Well played! Just the one ball to go. On off, Stone defends it.
This is outside off, Stone lets it be. 2 more balls to negotiate for him.
A short one and it is outside off, Stone looks to pull but misses.
Goes fuller again and on middle, this is hit to mid on.
Yorker on middle, this is jammed out.
Mark Adair is back!

SIX! What a strike from Broad. Another short ball from  Thompson but this time Broad is ready for it and pulls it past the deep square leg fielder for a maximum. Broad is playing a very handy innings here.
Short ball outside leg stump, Broad tries to glance but misses it.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Broad defends it to the off side.
Another short one from Stuart outside off stump, Broad tries to cut it but fails to get anything on it.
Short ball over the head of Broad who tries to nudge it over third man but misses.
Short ball outside off stump, Broad clears his legs and attempts to slog it away but misses.
On the pad, Stone works it to the man at mid-wicket.
This is floated up on off, Stone lunges forward and defends it onto the ground.
Flatter and on off, this is kept out.
Slower through the air outside off, Broad looks to drive but it goes uppishly, wide of point for one.

NOT OUT! There is actually a spike as the ball goes past the glove which means Ireland lose their review. This is flatter and on middle, Broad looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Ireland review but replays show it has brushed the glove.
Review time! Ireland feel they have got the last wicket but the umpire feels different as he turns down an appeal for an LBW. Looks close, umpire's call maybe.
Clever batting! Broad uses his reach and makes this into a full toss. Paddles it fine down the leg side for a brace.
The last man in is Olly Stone.

OUT! In the air... taken! End of the entertainment as Curran walks back but not after he has played a very good hand. England are nine down and they lead by 171. This is short and on middle, Curran looks to pull but does not get on top of the bounce. It goes off the top edge towards deep square leg where McCollum takes a good catch.
A bumper and Curran lets it go to the keeper. He wants a wide but the umpire does not signal it.
One more single! This is bowled outside off, Broad carves it towards deep point for one.
Just a single! Curran goes for the big heave but does not get it right, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Curran dances down the track but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
Short delivery on middle stump, Curran blocks it out.
Stuart Thompson is back!
This is around off, Curran punches it towards cover for a single.
Short again on off, Curran defends it off the back foot.
On the pads, Curran flicks it to the on side but straight to the fielder.
SIX! Going..going...gone! Tossed up on off, Curran heaves it over long off. The man at long off is just a spectator as he watches the ball sail over his head.
Shorter on off, Curran taps it back to the bowler.
Floated on the stumps, Curran blocks it.
Andy McBrine back on.
Corrects his line and bowls it full on middle, Broad pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Poor from Adair. He bowls it full down the leg side, Broad just helps it on its way fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Good length ball around off, Curran runs it down to third man for a single.

In the air...but safe! Good length ball around off, Curran looks to go over mid off. He does not time it well but times it well enough to send it away from the mid off fielder. Porterfield there runs behind and puts a dive but cannot get close to it. 2 runs taken.
On middle and leg, Curran blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! Curran goes aerial once again. Full around off, Curran lofts it over mid off. There is no one on long off so no risk there. The ball bounces before the ropes and goes away for a boundary.
Short balls are not helping Ireland. It was bowled on the legs and Broad glances off his legs towards fine leg for another couple. This ends a poor over from Rankin.
Another short delivery, Broad faces no problem in pushing it to the point fielder.
Back of a length delivery, Broad rocks and pushes it to the leg side.
Leg Bye! Rankin keeps on bowling short but this time on the legs. Curran tries to glance it but gets hit on the pads and rolls to fine leg for a single.

SIX! Curran is going all guns blazing here. Good length ball around off, Curran shuffles across and lofts his flick fine down the leg side. The ball bounces just on the ropes. The umpires have a look upstairs and then signal it as a six.
FOUR! What a shot from Curran. He is playing a handy innings here. It was another short delivery from Rankin and Curran just sits back and bashes it through covers for a boundary. Excellent batting.

FOUR! Up and above! This is bowled full and wide outside off, Broad gets on the front foot and lofts it over the cover point fielder. The fielders give it a chase but the ball wins the race. Four runs awarded to England.
Yorker outside the off stump, Broad pushes this one to the cover point fielder.
Full ball on the off pole, Broad plays it back to the bowler.
A little too straight, Broad looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Another back of a length ball on off, Broad guides it to point.
Slightly shorter around off, Broad guides it to point.
Bouncer bowled by Rankin on middle and leg, Curran goes onto the back foot and plays the hook shot towards deep square leg. The fielder in the deep cuts it off as the batters take a couple.
Bowled on the body of Curran, he plays this one down towards the leg side.

DROPPED! Difficult to call it that though. That is a tremendous effort by Porterfield. It is short and around off, Curran drags it towards wide mid on. Porterfield there jumps and has one hand stretched upwards. The ball hits that hand but does not stick in. It goes behind for two. Would have been an absolute blinder.
Another back of a length ball on off, Curran stands tall and guides it to point.
Length ball on off, Curran plays it to point.

FOUR! Curran getting some handy runs here. This is a bad ball by Rankin, he bowls it short and on the leg side. Curran tries to pull and gets just an inside edge on it but it is enough to take it to the fine leg fence.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
Good length ball on the pads, he tries to flick it but misses. The ball rolls to fine leg but no runs taken.
Stuart Broad walks out at number 10. Can he hang around with Sam Curran and add some valuable runs for his side?

OUT! Another one bites the dust! England are 8 down now. Their dressing room just can't believe what is happening. Adair gets his third. Once again Woakes flashes at a ball which was not there to be hit. It is just behind a driving length outside off. Woakes goes after it but the ball hits the outside edge and goes low towards second slip. Balbirnie takes a good catch. Woakes is disgusted as he walks back and Ireland are delighted. England are effectively 126 for 8.
Length ball on off, Woakes leaves it alone.
Goes wide of the crease and angles this one into the off pole, Chris defends it out.
Attacks the off again, Woakes defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Woakes defends it onto the ground.
Flat on middle and leg, Sam pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on leg, Woakes flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Woakes gets on his back foot and cuts it perfectly through point for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Woakes plays it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Woakes tries to smash it down the ground. Andy gets down to his left and stops the ball going through. The fielder at mid on collects it.
Flighted on middle, Woakes plays it to the leg side.

Just short! Another excellent delivery. This lands on a length and on off, Curran looks to defend but due to the angle away, it goes off the outside edge but falls just short of the diving second slip fielder to his right. Curran played that with soft hands and that is what saved him there.
Another one outside off, the batter does not fiddle with it.
Lands this one outside off, Curran leaves it alone this time.

FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Brilliant. Ireland just can't relax, this guy can really bat well. The first ball he faces, is a length ball outside off. Curran hits it on the up through covers. The fielder gives it a chase and tries to pull it back in but fails to do so.
Sam Curran is the new man in for England.

OUT! There goes Joe Root! The dropped catch has not cost a lot. Adair who has been Ireland's best bowler today, has got the big fish. An excellent catch too by Wilson. Also, that wicket means, the last recognized batsman is out of here. 150 now looks difficult. Root takes a few steps ahead and Adair bowls it just ahead of a length and around off. It shapes away. Root looks to drive but the length is not quite there. The outside edge is induced and it goes towards first slip. Wilson dives and takes it. England are effectively 117 for 6.
On the off pole, Root lunges and defends it.
Mark Adair is back on.
Woakes pushes this flighted one back to the bowler.
Flicks this full one towards mid-wicket. The batters cross and take a run.
Full length ball on the pads, Root flicks it towards square leg.
Root comes down the track, the bowler sees it and pulls the length a bit short. This is hit back to the bowler.
Flat again on the off pole, Root pushes it to mid on.
Flatter on off, Joe pushes it back to the bowler.
Andy McBrine is back!
On middle, Root works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Just outside off, Root does not fiddle with it.
Slightly shorter in length and on off, Root pushes it to mid on.
A little too straight, Root works it with soft hands through backward square leg and takes an easy two. The weight on the shot was perfect.
On a length and around off, Root defends it off the front foot.
Fuller and on middle, Root shows the full face of the bat and hits it to mid on.
Length ball on leg pole, Woakes gets on the back foot and defends it.

FOUR! Another one. Woakes getting some handy runs here. This is on a good length around off, Woakes opes the face of his bat and just nonchalantly guides the ball in the gap near the third man region. Four runs awarded to England.
FOUR! Woakes is off the mark in style. The ball was short and well outside off, Woakes rocks onto the back foot and pushes this ball through the empty point region for a boundary.
Length ball on  middle, Root goes onto the back foot and tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, Root does not play at those.
On off, Root stands tall and keeps it out.
On the pads of Woakes, he flicks it to short mid-wicket where the fielder runs to his left and collects it.
Good length ball around off by Murtagh, Woakes pushes it towards cover fielder.
Length ball on off, Woakes plays it back to the bowler.
Similar ball again, Root comes on the front foot and flicks towards leg side for a single.
Good length ball on off, Root plays it towards front of square leg for a couple.

Edged, just short and FOUR! Heart in the mouth moment for England. This is on a length and around off, it straightens after pitching. Root defends inside the line. The ball goes off the outside edge and underneath the hands of Stirling at first slip who fails to get down in time and into the third man fence. The lead is over 100 now.
Back of a length ball on off, Woakes defends it off the back foot.
Bouncer! Woakes is welcomed by a short one, he sits under it.
The new man in is Chris Woakes.

OUT! Caught behind! Moeen Ali cannot do much as he too walks back. Rankin bangs it in short. It comes in with the angle, the ball also keeps rising onto him. Moeen has a poke at it and ends up getting a feather on it. It goes straight to Gary Wilson who takes a simple catch. England are technically 6 down for 97. Moeen Ali's poor run of form continues. Ireland have comeback into this match like a raging bull.
Good length ball on the off pole, Root goes onto the back foot and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
This one comes in with the angle. It is pitched around off, Root defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Root taps it back to the bowler.
Full ball outside off, pushed towards point.
Murtagh bowls it on a good length around off, it hits the upper part of Moeen's bat. The ball goes to point.
Fullish ball on the leg pole, Ali pushes it back to Murtagh.
Length ball on the off pole, Ali plays it back to the mid on fielder.
A little too straight, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On the off pole, Root defends it nicely.
Root plays this full ball off his pads towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Short ball on the head height by Rankin, Ali plays the hook shot. It uppishly goes towards the square leg region but there is no one there. The batters take a single.
On the pads of Root, he tries to flick but misses. It hits his pads and rolls to square leg as the batters cross.
Bowled way down the leg side by Rankin. Root lets it be.
Bowled on the hips of Ali, he guides this one down to fine leg for one.
Length ball just outside off, Ali blocks it out.
Boyd Rankin to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Nicely played! A boundary to end! This is shorter and outside off, Root waits for it and then guides it down to the third man fence.
Well bowled! In the corridor of uncertainty. Root shoulders arms to that one.
Attacks the stumps and bowls it fuller on off, Root pushes it to mid on.
The keeper is up now. Gary Wilson is standing up for Murtagh.
This is outside off, Root shoulders arms to it.
On off, Root pushes it back to the bowler.
Murtagh starts the session by bowling a good length ball on off, Root takes a few steps ahead and defends it.
We are back for the final session on Day 2. England skipper, Root and Moeen Ali walk out to resume their innings. Tim Murtagh to bowl the first over of this final session.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Ireland on the other hand, suddenly hit the right lines and lengths in the second half of this session. Their bowlers got the ball to swing, especially Adair who has been really impressive. They know if they get a couple more quickly, they would then feel, they have a real chance. A really exciting last session awaits. Join us in a while.

What a session this was! 87 runs and 4 wickets in it. The game hangs in the balance as the players make their way in for Tea. It started off though with England having their noses ahead. They entered the session at 122 for 1 and Leach and Roy continued from where they left off in the previous session. They kept scoring freely until Thompson knocked Roy over. Then, Leach fell 8 short of a ton. Denly and Bairstow did not stay at the crease for long and all of a sudden England found themselves in a spot of bother. They lead by only 87 runs though they have the ever reliable skipper, Root, the batters coming in are not in great form. The hosts would hope, the others play around him and Root scores something big.
Once again short of the man at short leg. On the pads and bowled at pace. Moeen flicks but it comes off the higher part of his bat. It falls short of short leg once again.

OH! That was not far away from the man at short leg. Rankin hits the deck hard on off, it comes in with the angle. Moeen gets beaten for the pace. It clips his glove and then goes onto hit his elbow. The ball then falls short of the diving short leg fielder.
Once again it is on top of middle, Root glances it towards fine leg. This time though he gets just a single.
On off, Root flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Good length ball on off, Moeen plays it with soft hands towards covers for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Moeen does well to keep it down.
Good length delivery on off stump, Root dances down and defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on the pads, Ali glances it towards  square leg for a single
Outside off, Moeen leaves it alone.
Short ball on off stump, Ali defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
FOUR! Moeen Ali gets his first boundary of the game! Adair bowls it at a good length outside off stump, Ali tries to drive only for him to edge it past the third man fielder for a boundary.
On the pads, Moeen turns it to the on side and gets off the mark. He won't grab a pair of ducks here.
Once again it is top of off, Moeen blocks it off the back foot.
On top of off, Ali defends it back towards the bowler.
Follows it up with a single down towards fine leg.
FOUR! Rankin is guilty of bowling a loose ball. He gives width outside off, the English Test skipper pounces on it and late cuts it through third man for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, Root blocks it off his back foot.
The new man in is Moeen Ali. Also, Boyd Rankin is back.

OUT! Umpire's call it is. Bairstow grabs a pair in this innings. Just like in the first innings, it is the inswinging ball which has outdone him. It is pitching around off and comes back in after pitching.Bairstow looks to defend but plays all over it. The Irish players put a loud and confident appeal. Aleem Dar agrees with him. Bairstow takes it upstairs straightaway. Replays roll in, Ultra Edge shows no involvement of bat. Ball Tracker rolls in later on and shows that the ball was clipping the top of middle and leg. Not the start to the Test summer Bairstow would have wanted. Maybe the gruesome World Cup campaign has taken it's toll on him. England lead by 72, meaning they are half the side down under 100 here.
England have taken a review for LBW. Bairstow has been adjudged LBW. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Another play and miss! Good length ball outside off stump, Bairstow pushes at it missing it completely.
Back off a length delivery from Adair, Bairstow pushes at it but it goes past the bat.
Good length outside off stump, Bairstow lets it go.
On a good length on middle stump, Bairstow plays it towards the leg side.
Good length ball outside off stump, Bairstow facing his first ball leaves it alone.
A dot to end! On off, Root keeps it out.
Brings the sweep shot out but can't get past short fine leg.
On middle, Root works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on the stumps, Root defends it.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ireland are back in the game! From 171 for 1, England are now 194 for 4. Denly, who has been short of runs has been run out. Surely that is the last way he would have wanted to be dismissed and surely it is the last thing England would have wanted. England are effectively 72 for 4. This is on off, Root works it towards mid-wicket and calls for a run but then throws Denly the dummy who is halfway down the track. Too difficult for Denly to get back now. He does try but Kevin picks the ball up and throws it to the bowler who whips the bails off. Denly is way short. He walks back disappointed and Ireland are elated.
On off, this is kept out.
Back of a length ball on off, Denly defends it off the back foot.
Full on off, Denly flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length ball outside off, Denly has no business with it.
Length delivery on off, Denly defends it towards mid on.
Outside off on a length, Denly shoulders arms to it.
Good length ball outside off, Root strokes it towards point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Denly drives it straight back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery outside off stump, Root punches it off the backfoot to the off side for a single
Loopy delivery on off stump, Root pushes it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, Denly turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full delivery on middle stump, Root pushes it towards mid on and take off for a quick single.
Loopy delivery, Root prods forward and defends it to the off side.
Spinner back on. Andy McBrine is back into the attack.
Outside off, Denly leaves it alone.
An away swinging full toss outside off. It is very low, Denly drives it off the inner half of his bat to the bowler.
Outside off, Denly leaves it alone.
Fuller on off, JD blocks it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Denly defends it off the front foot.
Fuller ball on off, Denly looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of his bat towards point.
Mark Adair is back on.
Fuller on off, Root pushes it to cover.
NO BALL! Errs in line this time. It was a full delivery outside leg stump, Root tries to play a glance but is unable to put bat on it.
Good length ball outside off stump, Root comes forward and defends it to the off side.
A good length delivery outside off stump, Root lets it go to the keeper.
Good delivery from Thompson. Bowled on a good length outside off stump, Root pushes at it but misses it.
This time a full delivery on the pads, Joe glances it towards square leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle stump, Denly pushes it to mid on.
Slightly shorter around off, Root defends it off the front foot.
Outside off on a length, Root leaves it alone.
On off, Root blocks it off the front foot.
Full outside off, Root pushes it stylishly to cover.
This is pitched around off, it comes back in after pitching. Denly turns it away towards square leg for one.
Fuller on off, Denly defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery on off stump, Root pushes it to the point fielder.
Good length ball outside off stump, Denly glances it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Low full toss on the pads, Root flicks it towards deep square leg.
Good length delivery outside leg stump, Root tries to flick it but ends up missing it.
Full delivery on the pads, Denly plays a classy glance but straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Fuller length delivery on off stump, Denly drives it towards mid off. No run.
Full again, this is closer to the off stump. Root blocks it off the  front foot.
Fuller on off, Root comes out of his crease and defends it.
Skipper, Joe Root walks out to bat now.

OUT! Caught! No hundred for Jack Leach either. Finally Ireland manage to take Leach's catch. Murtagh gets his first of the innings. Good length ball around off, it moves away after pitching. Leach has a poke at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes straight to Adair at second slip. He makes no mistake this time and takes a very simple catch. End of a brilliant knock from Leach. What a knock this has been from Leach! He came out as a night watchman but he has done his job as a proper batsman. He walks out to a well-deserved standing ovation. England lead by 60 here but they have lost 3 wickets.
Hits the deck hard around off, Jack defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball around off, Leach punches it to the off side.

Dropped! This looks like Jack Leach's day. Earlier Wilson dropped him and now Adair is the culprit. Good length ball outside off, Leach looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which flies to the left of second slip. Mark Adair there gets his hands to it but cannot bask it in.
Short ball on middle stump, Leach flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full on off, Jack pushes it to mid off.
NO BALL! Thompson oversteps. It was a short ball on off stump, Leach defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery on off stump, Leach rocks back and pushes the ball towards the cover fielder who misfields and allows the batsmen to take two.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Leach cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Leach punches it straight to the point fielder.
Good length ball on off stump, Leach defends it to the off side.

Very well played! Full around off, Denly gets on his front foot and drives it through covers. The fielder at short cover gets his hand to it but cannot stop it. It was in fact half a chance for the fielder there but a tough one. He though takes the pace off the ball meaning it does not reach the fence. Two taken.
Outside off and no movement on this one. Joe shoulders arms to it.
Fuller on the stumps, JD defends it with a straight bat.
Good length ball on off, Denly defends it off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Denly pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Denly looks to defend but gets hit on the box.
Short ball, on the body, Leach hangs back and plays it on the leg side for a dot ball.
Good length outside off stump, Leach leaves it alone.
Errs in line. It was a short delivery outside leg stump, Leach attempts to pull but misses it.
Good length outside off stump, Leach lets it go to the keeper.
Full delivery, Denly drives it towards mid off and take off for a single and with that Denly gets off the mark
Short ball outside off stump, Denly leaves it alone.
On the stumps, Leach defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Misfield from the skipper. Full outside off, Leach drives it through extra cover. Porterfield runs to his left and looks to gather it but misses. The ball goes through him for a boundary. The lead is now past 50. This boundary also brings up 1000 first-class runs for Jack Leach.
On off, Leach pushes it to mid off.
On the stumps, Leach defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball around off, Leach plays it to the man at point.
Full on off, Leach strokes it to the man at cover.
Similar line and length, this time Denly softly pushes it to the cover fielder off the front foot.
Full ball outside off pole. Denly drives it to the cover fielder where he dives to his right and saves.
Oh! Fuller inswinging ball on off, Denly strokes it to cover.
Joe Denly is the new man.

OUT! Bowled! No debut hundred for Roy. Thompson comes steaming in and bowls a beautiful inswinging ball. It is full and pitching on off. Roy looks to drive it on the up but misreads the swing on it. There is a big gap between the bat and pad and the ball goes through that gap to disturb the stumps. 145-run stand comes to an end. England lead by 49. Ireland needed some inspiration and this wicket might just bring them that. Much needed wicket for the visitors.
Play and a miss! Good ball! Length ball on the fifth stump line, it pitches and nips away from Roy. He looks in two minds to play at it or not, eventually he leaves it.
Length ball on the pads of Roy, he helps it down to the fine leg fielder and takes two.
Stuart Thompson is back on. Replaces Boyd Rankin.
On the stumps, Leach defends it off the front foot to see through a very good over for England. 8 runs came off the over.
Good length ball around off, Leach cuts it hard but straight to the man at point.
FOUR! This is a gorgeous shot from Leach. Fuller around off, Leach gets on his front foot and plays a textbook cover drive drive for a boundary.
Outside off, Leach looks to drive this on the up but misses.
Now follows it up with a solid front foot defense.

UP...AND JUST OVER FOR FOUR! Murtagh bowls a full ball around off, Leach hits it over mid off. Rankin, one of the tallest players in the game jumps but cannot get his hand on it. Leach would have had his heart in his mouth there for a minute.
Tim Murtagh is back on.
Again down the leg side, there seems to be a noise but looks like the ball has hit the thigh pad here on its way to the keeper. The Irish appeal in hope but the umpire turns it down.
Down the leg side, Roy swings his bat at it but misses.
Good running here! Good length ball on off, Leach plays it towards the cover point fielder with soft hands and quickly scampers across for a single.
Down the leg side this time, Leach swings his bat trying to connect but misses. It hits his thigh on the way to the keeper.
NO BALL! Not for overstepping but because Ireland have two fielders behind square on the leg side. Good length ball on the off pole, Jack pushes it back to the bowler
Defended off the back foot!
FOUR! Short and outside off by Rankin, Leach takes full advantage of it as he hops and cuts the ball towards the empty point region for a boundary.

Drinks break! England going strength to strength here. The duo of Leach and Roy are looking good. The luck too has gone their way as Wilson put down a sitter of Jack Leach. Ireland bowlers look out of ideas here and they need to find some inspiration from somewhere.
Another short ball. This time Roy waits back in his crease and looks to hit it over the slips but misses.
Bouncer! A typical fast bowler's response. Roy comes down the track and looking at the short trajectory sways away from it.
FOUR! Deft touch! Good length ball around off, Roy waits for the ball to come and in the last moment opens the face of the bat to send it through the third man fence for a boundary.
Better this from Adair. It is closer to the off pole, JR defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Adair gives width outside off, Roy says thank you very much and creams it through point for a boundary.
On the stumps, Roy defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it fuller than the last one around off, Leach punches it to mid off.
In the air but safe again! Short ball on the body, Leach looks to negotiate it but ends up slicing it. Luckily it is towards the vacant square leg region.

DROPPED! Lifeline given to Leach. It was an easy catch for Gary Wilson here. This is a great ball by Rankin, it pitches on good length on the fourth stump line and nips away from Leach. He gets an outside edge this time and it carries to the keeper, Wilson on waist height. He goes to his left trying to take an easy catch but lets it through his hands. The night watchman for England survives to die another day.
Good length ball this time on off, pushed to the mid off fielder.
Good ball by Rankin. Short of a length it rises near chest height, Leach does well to get on top of it and defends it into the ground.
On the pads, Length ball on the pads of Roy, he glances it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Leach looks to defend but misses.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Adair is guilty of bowling full outside off, Leach strides forward and drives it exquisitely through point for a boundary.
Fuller on off, Leach plays it to mid off.
Comes around the wicket to the left-hander and bowls it on off. Leach defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball around off, Roy strokes it towards point and gets a single.
Full on off and middle, Roy strokes it to mid on.
Outside off, Leach looks to drive but misses.
Back of a length ball on off, Leach defends it off the back foot foot.

DROPPED AND FOUR! The change in field almost worked for Ireland here. They put in the leg slip just a couple of balls ago and it looked like he was in business here. Rankin bowls it on the pads of Jack, he tries to flick it towards fine leg but does not time it properly. The fielder tries to catch as he dives way towards his right and gets a hand to it. However, he cannot take the catch neither can he stop it going for a boundary.
Down the leg side by Rankin, Leach tries to flick it but misses. The keeper collects the ball.
Good length ball on off, Leach defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, Leach looks to flick but it goes off his thigh pad behind the keeper. They take two leg byes.
Now defends it off the front foot.

Huge appeal for LBW but turned down. Full inswinging ball. It pitches on off and comes back in a lot. Roy does not pick this one and looks to play it straight. He misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal but it is turned down by the umpire. The ball looks to be doing too much though as Porterfield opts against the review.
Roy comes down the track and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Around off, Roy edges it towards third man and gets a couple.
On top of the stumps, Roy defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Roy pushes it to mid off.
Leach gets behind the line of this length delivery and blocks it out.
Another shortish ball outside off, this time Leach gets an underedge on it. The ball rolls towards gully.
Play and a miss! Rankin pitches this on a length outside off, Leach goes for the cut but misses the ball altogether.
Length ball pitched outside off, Jack gets in line of the ball and defends it.
On the pads again, Leach flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.

FOUR! Not the best of balls from Rankin. He bowls it on the body, Leach just helps it fine down the leg side. Wilson, behind the stumps dives to his right but cannot get close to the ball. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Roy shoulders arms to this one.
On the legs of Roy, he glances it towards fine leg for a couple.
Appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. Inswinging ball, Roy looks to defend but misses. He gets a feather on it onto his back pad. There is a stifled appeal but turned down by the umpire.
Full ball on the off pole, Roy uppishly plays it towards mid on but it falls well short of the fielder.
Length ball drifting onto the hips of Jack, the ball hits the thigh pad of the batter.
Full ball just outside off, Leach blocks it towards cover.
Mark Adair to partner Rankin in this new session from the other end.
Oh! Beaten! Much better this from Rankin. Pulls his length back outside off. The ball comes in and then moves away after pitching. Roy looks to defend but gets beaten comprehensively.

FOUR! Whipped and whipped away in style. Full around off, Roy flicks it across the line through mid-wicket for a boundary. He holds the pose for the cameras. That also brings up the 100-run stand between the two. This has been a good partnership for England. A much needed one.
On top of middle, Roy blocks it with a straight bat.
Short ball but it is down the leg side. Roy goes for the pull but misses.
Fuller on off, Roy pushes it to the man at mid off.
Starts the new session with a good length ball on off and middle, Roy defends it off the front foot.
We are back for the 2nd session on Day 2. Jason Roy and Jack Leach walk out to the middle to resume their innings. Boyd Rankin will start the second session with the ball for Ireland.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Nothing much to write about the Irish bowling. If the first session on Day 1 was magical for them then this has been tiring. Only Boyd Rankin has been in the wickets column so far. The Ireland bowlers started to look tired as the session progressed. They will be happy with the break. They will need to regroup and rethink their plan coming into the second session. Join us in a while for the second session of Day 2.

A very contrasting Lunch for England from the one they had on Day 1. Though England lost Rory Burns relatively early, the night watchman, Jack Leach has played like a proper batsman. Him and Roy, who is playing his maiden Test have both reached their respective maiden Test fifties and have wiped out England's deficit. The duo have added 96 runs and have looked quite comfortable out in the middle.

Excellent delivery by Adair to end the session. He pitches this one outside off, but this time, the ball swings back in with the angle. Leach shoulders arms to this one but even he didn't expect it would be this close to the wickets. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Beaten! Good bowling here by Adair. This one pitches on the fifth stump line and nips away from the left-handed Leach. He tries to push it back to the bowler but plays inside the line of the ball.
Length ball on middle and off, Leach comes onto the front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Pitched on a good length outside off, Leach shoulders arms to this one.
Bowls it on a length on the off pole, the ball swings away and misses the bat of Leach.
The ball pitches on middle and off and drifts away, Leach leaves it alone.
Mark Adair is back into the attack now.
Fuller on leg and middle, Roy pushes it to mid on.

FOUR! Roy gets to his fifty in style. This is his maiden Test fifty in his debut Test. Thompson bowls a length ball outside off, Roy  takes full toll of it and smashes it through point for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Roy nudges it through mid on for a couple.
On middle, Roy defends it towards mid on.
Now a full toss. It swings late and goes on to the pads, Leach flicks it to fine leg and gets a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Leach defends it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Roy flicks it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.

Flatter and shorter this time on off, Leach goes onto the back foot and plays it late towards the third man region. The fielders give it a chase and retrieve the ball as the batters run and take three.
Tossed up a bit on a good length on off, Leach comes down the ground and defends it.
Comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on off pole, Leach plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Roy comes down the track and strokes it to long on for one.
Good length ball on off, Leach defends it to get through the over.
Full on middle and off, Roy flicks it beautifully but there is a man in the deep at mid-wicket so just a single.
On the body, Leach tucks it with ease through mid-wicket. Roy was looking for the second but Leach sends him back.
Down the leg side, Leach looks to flick but misses.
Fuller on middle and off, Roy flicks it off the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for one.
Good length ball around off, Roy defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on the stumps, JL defends it off the front foot.
Once again Leach takes no risk and blocks it.
Floated on the stumps, Leach defends it off the front foot.
Short outside off, Roy late cuts it towards the third man region. The batters comeback for the third by the time the fielder mops it up.
Now defends it off the front foot.

IN THE AIR...AND FOUR! Floated on off, Roy looks to play the big sweep. He does not time it well and ends up top edging it over vacant square leg region for a boundary. Brings up the 100 for England. The trail now is under 20.
Down the leg side on a yorker length. Roy flicks it to the fine leg region and keeps strike.

FOUR! Uppishly over cover! The Irish players thought that there was a chance but it would have been a blinder if the fielder took that catch. Thompson bowls it full way outside off, Roy gets on the front foot and drives it towards the cover region. The ball flies uppishly but luckily there was no one there. Four runs awarded to England.
Full on the pads, Roy looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
This time it is on a good length. Roy gets an inside edge to it and the ball rolls to mid on.
Fuller this time on the middle pole, Roy pushes the ball to mid-wicket.

Huge appeal from LBW but turned down by the umpire. Thompson steams in and bowls a inswinging ball. It pitches on off, Roy looks to play it straight but misses. The ball hits him on his front pad. There is a huge shout for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Porterfield, the bowler and the keeper get together for a chat. Porterfield looks to signal the T but the time is up.
Shorter on the pads, Leach looks to flick but misses and the ball goes onto hit the thigh pad.
Now calmly defends this ball off the front foot.
FOUR! Aggression from Leach. Tossed up on off and middle, Jack comes down the track and lofts his flick over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a flighted ball on off, Leach defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Roy comes down the track and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Roy pushes it to cover.
Down the leg side by Thompson. Leach tries to whip it away towards fine leg but misses.
Length ball outside off again. This time Leach leaves it alone.
Tries to slash at this wide delivery outside off, Leach misses the ball and it carries to the keeper.

EDGED AND FOUR! Not the most beautiful way to get to your maiden Test 50 but this has been a brilliant knock from Leach. He came on as a night watchman but has batted like a proper opener. Full outside off, Leach looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes through the vacant third slip region and to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Leach defends it off the front foot.

Oh! Beaten! Good ball by Thompson this. It pitches on the off pole and nips away a bit from Leach. He tries to push at it off the back foot but plays inside the line of the ball. The ball narrowly misses the outside edge of the bat. Thompson should keep bowling this consistently.
On the pads, JR flicks it but to the man at mid-wicket.
Flighted on the stumps, Roy defends it off the front foot.
Short outside off, Roy cuts it through backward point. Kevin O'Brien once again cleans it up. Two runs taken.
Now calmly blocks this ball. Sensible batting this.
SIX! Roy has decided to take on the spinner here. Tossed up on off, Jason comes down the track and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

Good fielding! McBrine starts with a short ball around off, Roy waits and cuts it hard through point. O'Brien in the deep runs to his right and pulls it back before the ropes. Saves 2 runs for his side.
Spin into the attack now. For the first time in this game, Andy McBrine will bowl. Didn't bowl a single over in the first innings.
FOUR! Moves to 47 with that glorious drive. Overpitched ball on off, Leach gets his front foot on the line and drives it handsomely through mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle,Leach gets on top of the bounce and keeps it down.
Full on off, Leach drives it straight. Thompson gets down in time and does well to stop the ball.
Outside off on a length, Jack shoulders arms to it.
Once again Leach plays a very good drive but finds the fielder.
Full ball around off, Leach strokes it to cover.
Stuart Thompson is on now!
Good shot but the straight drive is too straight. Full on off, Roy drives it straight but the ball goes onto hit the stumps at the bowler's end.
Little to no movement on this one. It is on off, Roy blocks it out without any fuss.
Oh! This one comes back in after pitching. Roy does not pick that up. He looks to defend but it goes off the inner half of his bat towards square leg.
Good length ball on off, Roy defends it off the back foot.

Good footwork from both the batsman and the bowler. Full ball around off, Roy gets on his front foot and drives it to the right of the bowler through the inner half of his bat. Murtagh stretches out his right leg and makes a stop with his feet.
Good length ball close to the off stump, Roy defends it with confidence.
Length ball just outside off, Leach pushes this to cover point.
Similar line and length this time around, Leach leaves it alone.
Short of a length by Rankin. Leach pushes it down on the ground and back to the bowler.
Beaten! This one is shorter on off near the body, Leach tries to push it off the back foot towards mid on. He plays inside the line of the delivery and misses the ball.
Outside off by Rankin, Leach shoulders arms to this one.
This is on the pads, Leach looks to flick but misses to get hit on it. There is an appeal from the bowler but the umpire is not interested.
Good length ball on off stump, Roys blocks it towards the off side.
Another good length delivery swinging in a little, Leach whips it towards fine leg.
Good length delivery on off stump, Leach prods forward and defends it to the off side.
Outside off, Leach shoulders arms to this one.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Leach pushes it to point fielder for a dot ball.
Leg Bye! Good length delivery on middle stump, Roy comes forward to flick it through the leg side but gets hit on the pad for a single.
Bowls this one on the pads, Leach looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes to the keeper who stops it with a dive.
Well bowled and well played! This is shorter and outside off, Leach initially looks to play at it but then bails out.
BEATEN! Goes fuller this time outside off, Leach is rooted to his crease as he looks to drive. Gets beaten.
Down the leg side, Leach leaves it.
Back of a length on off, Leach defends it out.
Not timed but good enough to get two! Length and around off, Leach strokes it on the up through covers and runs two. He moves onto 42.
FOUR! Good shot from Jason. That will give him a lot of confidence. Fuller delivery from Tim and Roy plays an excellent drive through cover for his third boundary of the game.
Short delivery on middle stump, Roy pushes it to the leg side for another dot ball.
Beautiful bowling from Murtagh. It was a good length delivery on off stump which Roy attempts to defend but misses it again.
Short ball on off stump, Roy blocks it towards mid off.
Excellent delivery from Murtagh. Short delivery outside off stump, Roy dances down the track to block it out but misses. The keeper has a throw at the stumps but Roy is well in.
Good length delivery on off stump, Roy comes forward and defends it to the leg side.
Not a good delivery to end! This is down the leg side, Leach looks to flick but misses.

Cut Leach into half! Good take by the keeper! This lands outside off and then jags back in. Leach fails to put bat on ball. It goes over the stumps. Wilson dives to his right and catches it with one hand.
This starts on off and angles back in. The length is a touch shorter. Leach looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Bowls this on the pads, Roy looks to flick but misses. It hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.

EDGY FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Roy comes down the track and looks to play it with an angled bat. The ball goes off the outside edge and through the vacant third slip area and into the third man fence.
OHHH! Good ball. This is on a length and around off, it pitches and jags back in. Roy looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Excellent over from Murtagh. It was on a good length shaping away from the batsman and Leach defends but misses the ball completely.
Shortish delivery on off stump, Leach cuts it hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Good ball from Murtagh. Back off a length delivery outside off stump, Leach fails to get any bat on it and misses.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Jack lets it go back to the keeper.
Fuller this time on middle stump, Leach works it past the mid-on and the mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Good length ball on leg stump, Leach flicks it but straight to the square leg fielder for a dot ball.
Tim Murtagh is back on now!
A quick single and Leach keeps strike! This is shortish and on off, Leach stands tall and pushes it towards cover for one. Another good over for England. The momentum seems to have changed here.
Goes back to bowling it outside off and slightly shorter. Leach lets it be.
FOUR! 50 up for England. Third boundary in the over. This is on the pads, Leach works it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence. 27 runs in the last 10 balls.
Shorter and on off, this is defended off the back foot.
The ball is being checked, it seems like it has lost its shape. The umpires feel it is okay though.
FOUR! Leach is oozing in confidence here. This is hit on the up. Slightly fuller and around off, Leach strokes it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries here! This is very full and on middle, Leach pushes it past mid on and the ball races away. The fielder did give it a chase but finished second.

FOUR! This time Roy does not miss out on the half volley. It was another good length delivery on off stump, Roy after missing out on the last ball creams it past the cover fielder for another boundary.
On a good length outside off stump, Roy attempts to drive it instead gets an inside edge towards mid on. No run.
FOUR! Roy is off the mark in style! Not off the middle but Roy won't care. This is fuller and around off, Roy looks to go hard at it but it goes off the inner half through mid off for a boundary.
Three! Fuller ball on off stump, Leach once again drives it down the ground but it will not go for four this time. The mid off fielder runs after it and throws it back. The batsmen take three.
Bowls it on a good length this time on off stump, Leach defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Leach. His third boundary of the game. It was a full delivery from Adair on off stump, Leach is ready for it and drives it past mid off for a four.
An appeal but it is a little too high. This is angled into the batter. Roy looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. End of a successful over for Rankin.
Slips this one down the leg side, Roy lets it be.
Jason Roy is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The bowling change works wonders for Ireland. Boyd Rankin strikes in his first over itself, just like he did in the first innings. He gets one full and nicks the batter off. However, the shot might not have been needed there. This is on a length and outside off, Burns could have left it but he pokes at it. An outside edge is induced and it goes into the mitts of the keeper. First breakthrough for Ireland. England still 96 away.
Shorter in length again and outside off, this time Leach chops it towards point for one.
FOUR! Slashes and does it well! Short and this is outside off, it sits up to be hit. Leach hops and slaps it through point for a boundary. England's trail under 100 now.
Starts off with a short ball on middle, Leach was ready for it, he ducks under it.
Boyd Rankin is on now!
Excellent delivery from Adair. Ball shapes away a little and Burns while trying to defend it misses it altogether.
Full delivery shaping away a little, Burns pushes it towards mid off.
Another full delivery on middle stump, Burns defends it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle stump, Burns defends it towards mid on.
Good length ball on off stump, Burns pushes it to cover for a dot ball.
Short ball outside off stump, Burns lets it go to the keeper.
Another length ball on off, Tim defends it to mid off.
Well played again! Leach is really frustrating the Irish here. Murtagh lands it on off, Leach keeps it out.
Shortish and outside off, this is guided to the man at point.
A mute appeal from the slip cordon! The noise was of the bat hitting the pad. This is angling away from off. Leach looks to defend but misses.
A short one on middle, Leach hops and nudges it to square leg.
Three! A little too straight, Burns works it through square leg and takes three.
Excellent yorker from Adair. It was an inswinging yorker directed on middle stump which Leach just abouts to keep it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Short ball on leg stump, Leach hangs back and flicks it towards the leg side for another dot ball.
Good length delivery on off stump, Leach is unable to put any bat on it and ball whizzes back to the keeper.
Loose stroke! Adair is getting the ball to move both ways. This time he takes it away and bowls it fuller outside off. Leach goes after it but misses.
No Ball! Adair oversteps. It was a very full inswinging delivery which surprises Leach and it hits the inside edge of the bat and goes on to hit the pad. No run.
Full delivery on off stump, Leach drives it past the point and cover fielder for a double.
A dot to end another tight over! This is shortish and around off, Burns guides it to point.
Continues bowling it on a length and around off, Burns looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and around middle, Burns works it to short mid-wicket which was just brought in.
Around off but a touch shorter, Burns works it to mid on.
On the off pole, RB keeps it out.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Burns is happy to leave it alone.
A little too straight, Leach looks to flick but misses. It hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. Leach wants a run but is sent back.
This time a fuller length outside off stump, Leach is unable to put bat on it and the ball rolls back to the keeper.
Short ball from Adair above the batsman's head, Leach ducks under it and lets it go back to the keeper.
Good delivery from Adair, on a good length on middle stump, Leach can only defend it back to the bowler.
On a good length again outside off stump, Leach leaves it alone.
On a good length on off stump, Leach prods forward to defend but misses it completely.
Back of a length on off, RB stands tall and keeps it out.
Fullish and on middle, Burns hits it to mid on.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Bonus runs! This is worked towards square leg by Leach. He takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a needless shy at the striker's end. The ball hits the stumps and deflects away from the fielder backing up and goes into the fence.
Beauty! Lovely use of the angle there. This lands on off and then slants away. Leach defends inside the line and gets beaten.
Well fielded! This is shorter and around middle, Burns works it towards mid-wicket. The fielder in front of square dives and pushes it towards mid on. He saves at least two for his side.
On a good length around off and angling away. Burns lunges and defends it onto the ground.
good length delivery outside off stump, Jack prods forward and plays it past the point fielder for a couple.
Another good length delivery,  outside off stump, Leach tries to block it out but misses the ball again.
Much better bowling from Adair, good length ball outside off stump, Leach attempts to defend but misses.
Another one down the leg side, Leach looks to flick but misses. Adair is bowling a little too straight. He should maybe change the angle.

BYE! Errs in line this time,bowls a short delivery but way outside leg stump, Burns lets it go and Wilson tries to make a diving stop to his left but cannot hold onto the ball. Allowing the batsmen cross over for a bye.
Short ball outside off stump, Burns pushes it to the cover fielder for a dot ball.

EDGY FOUR! Lucky for Leach. This is a great ball by Murtagh. It pitches on short of a length and drifts outside off on the fourth stump line for Leach. He plays at it but gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes through the gap at gully and third man region. It races away to the fence.
Continues bowling it tight on off stump, Leach defends it solidly.
Better this time by Leach, the ball is pitched on a good length around off. He gets on the front foot and plays it to the mid off fielder.

BEATEN! This one pitches on middle and leg and drifts away from Leach. He tries to get bat on ball but plays inside the line of the ball. It whizzes past the bat but luckily for England, Leach doesn't get an edge on it.
Good length ball just outside off, Leach play this one off the front foot to point.
Back of a length on off, Leach turns it towards the off side.
Tim Murtagh to continue from the other end.
England and Burns are underway! This is short and on the body, Rory works it towards fine leg and takes two.
A lovely delivery that! From around the wicket, he angles it into the off pole, gets it to leave the batter late. Burns plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Attacks the stumps again and lands it on a length, Burns is solid in defense.
Back of a length and on off, Burns stands tall and keeps it out.
Errs in line this time and bowls it down the leg side, Burns looks to flick but misses.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Burns shoulders arms to this one. Good carry there for the bowler.
We are all set for the action to begin! Rory Burns and Jack Leach to resume their innings. Mark Adair will start the proceedings for Ireland. Here we go...

Welcome to Day 2 of this one-off Test between England and Ireland. After a horrific day for the hosts they trail the Irish by 122. The hosts will need to put up a much better display after their horrendous performance on Day 1. The visitors, on the other hand, have a real chance to stun the World Champions and shock the cricketing world with a gigantic win at the home of cricket. The Irish bowlers will be looking to replicate their performance from Day 1. An intense battle awaits us on a hot and sunny day.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

England trail by 122 and they will need to bat well here if they are to avoid an upset. They are surely capable of doing so. Ireland on the other hand, will hope they can replicate their performance of the first innings. 20 wickets fell today! Will the bowlers dominate tomorrow as well or is Day 2 going to be one for the batters? We will have to wait to find out on Thursday 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

The hosts elected to bat and were bundled out for just 85 runs. Tim Murtagh was the star with the ball for them as he picked a maiden Test fifer. Many expected the English side to do the same to the Irish. However, the Irish top order showed great determination and at one stage, Ireland seemed like they could take a big first innings lead. However, after Tea, things changed. The English bowlers found their lines and lengths. They kept taking wickets at regular intervals and did not let Ireland run away with the game.

England or I should write Jack Leach has negotiated the six balls and England will enter Day 2 unscathed. What a day though of cricket we have had here. Yes, Ireland will be the happier side of the two but England won't be too disappointed after how the day began for them.
Leach survives! Full on the leg stump line, Leach defends it back to the bowler. That is Stumps on Day 1.
On off, Leach defends it off the front foot. There is a huge cheer from the crowd as he gets bat on ball. Last ball of the day coming up.
Just about survived. Good length ball outside off, Leach goes after it to defend but the ball just about misses the outside edge.
Once again no movement. It is on the pads, Leach tucks it to square leg. 3 balls remain in the day. Can Leach survive?
Outside off and no movement on this one. Leach shoulders arms to this one.
Oh! Good start! Good length ball outside off. It moves away a bit after pitching. Leach looks to defend but misses.
